headline: Meta brings its Muse AI agent to Australia
dek: According to Meta itself, the agent reaches its third confirmed market with local partners.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Muse arrives in Australia
body: Meta announced Muse's expansion to Australia, with local partners in shopping, real estate, fitness and entertainment (Meta Newsroom).
It is the third market the company has confirmed, after the US and Singapore.

s3.label: How it works
s3.title: What the agent does
s3.body: According to Meta, features roll out progressively.

points.t: Designs visuals at the user's request (Meta Newsroom).
Browses property listings via Domain (Meta Newsroom).
Helps buy through Kogan, MECCA and Officeworks (Meta Newsroom).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Safety and control
body: Meta says the user decides what Muse can access (Meta Newsroom).
Sensitive actions, such as purchases, happen only after confirmation, the company says.

items.t: Real-time voice chat on phone, web and Mac (Meta Newsroom).
Custom spaces the user creates (Meta Newsroom).
Meta did not say if Muse reaches other markets.

caption.hook: Meta brings Muse, its personal AI agent, to Australia.
body: Meta announced that Muse is arriving in Australia with local partners in shopping, real estate, fitness and entertainment, including Canva, Domain, Kogan, MECCA, Officeworks and Ticketek, according to the company (Meta Newsroom). It is the third confirmed market, after the United States and Singapore.

According to Meta, each partner's features roll out progressively, and sensitive actions such as purchases happen only after the user confirms (Meta Newsroom). The company also released real-time voice chat and Spaces, custom environments. Meta did not say whether Muse reaches other markets.
